subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary The national memorial at Savar is a symbol of the liberation war of Bangladesh. The foundation was laid on the first anniversary of the victory day. There is actually a series of seven towers. The most moving sight of complex is the several graves of the martyred freedom fighters close to the tower. People show respect to the martyred freedom fighters standing in front of the graves.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Police Line Secondary School, Jessore. Sl. No. 65; Page No. 112
